title: Foundation definitions
description: A foundation document covers a broad design domain a system is built on (color, typography, spacing, elevation, motion, shape, accessibility, content). It holds the subject's identity and metadata (see metadata/metadata.schema.json), plus its docs.

foundation.description: The principles, scales, and rules that govern a design subject (color, typography, spacing, elevation, motion, accessibility, content). A domain can be visual (color, spacing) or cross-cutting (accessibility, content). Its identity is `identifier`, `name`, and `description`. Its docs cover principles, scale, motion, guidelines, accessibility, content, and more.

kind.description: Identifies this entity as a foundation.

identifier.description: Machine-readable identifier for the foundation (ex: 'color', 'typography', 'spacing'). MUST be unique across the whole document, because references resolve to it document-wide.

description.description: What this foundation covers, the design domain it governs, and its role in the system. CommonMark supported.

metadata.description: Optional metadata: the shared entityMetadata fields (see metadata/metadata.schema.json).

relationships.description: Links from this foundation to other entities (ex: 'depends-on' the tokens it builds on). Tools derive the reverse relationships. Use `links` metadata for external resources instead.

documentBlocks.description: All structured docs for this foundation, in order. Accepts the foundation-specific kinds (principles, scale, motion) plus every general kind. Tools SHOULD keep this order for display. Put internal links (like a token group reference) in `links` metadata, not in a block entry.

agentDocumentBlocks.description: Docs exclusively for agents (AI/LLM), using the same block kinds as `documentBlocks`. Only use this for info that isn't useful to a person. Examples include hard must/must-not rules, notes that correct a mistake agents commonly make, and machine-checkable criteria. Put everything else in `documentBlocks`. Tools MUST NOT show these blocks to humans. Agents SHOULD read both arrays, human docs first.
